name: InLoop Robotics
long_description:
We are building AI-native fulfillment powered by robotics.
Warehouses without human labor that get better, faster, and cheaper with every order.

Most robotics companies wait until their system is perfect before deploying. We don't. We ship imperfect policies into real warehouses, detect failures in real time, recover automatically when we can, and bring in a remote human operator when we can't.

Every failure becomes training data. Every intervention makes the system better. The result is a fulfillment system that continuously learns from production.
one_liner: Robotic arms that pick and pack your orders.

launches.body:
**TL;DR**

**InLoop deploys robot employees you can hire by the month.** Our intelligent robotic arms pack, kit, and fulfill in warehouses, fulfillment centers, and factories. **We handle everything** else. Paid pilots **live in customer warehouses today**: **300+ picks/hour, generalizing across hundreds of SKUs**, **replacing** $100k+ integration projects per station.\
\
**_Ask:_** If you run ops at a warehouse, fulfillment center, or factory - what's the one repetitive task you wish a robot could just _do_ tomorrow? Tell us. We'll show you how: [https://www.inloop-robotics.com](https://www.inloop-robotics.com/)

Our launch video:\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=25SjZ28WX6Q>\
\
**Problem**

**Repetitive manual work in warehouses is the most expensive labor problem nobody has solved.**

* Ops leaders hire more than they operate: Warehouse turnover runs \~49% annually and exceeds 100% at peak-volume sites; peak season can't be staffed at any price.
* Existing automation breaks the moment your catalog shifts: traditional systems cost $200k–$1M+ upfront and lock you to a single set of SKUs
* The math doesn't work: ops leaders spend more time hiring than running the line, and most fulfillment still runs on humans doing the same six motions, 8 hours a day
* AI hasn't reached the physical world yet: software ate every digital workflow; the warehouse floor is still humans + conveyor belts

**Solution**

**You pick a task - packing, kitting, induction, palletizing. We deploy a robotic arm trained on it within weeks. It learns continuously. You pay a flat monthly fee.**

* **One policy handles thousands of SKUs.**
* **Human-in-the-loop teleop:** when the robot hits an edge case, a remote operator takes over control and your line never stops
* **Adapting to individual requirements: Quality, Speed and Reliability**
* **Zero capex, zero integration risk:** we ship it, run it, retrain it. Scale up or down with demand

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101547&key=user_uploads/2650485/6ce2b445-5f6a-4371-876c-e1251a0d4caa)

  \
  **This is the team building the next great robotics company.** Customers, investors, future teammates - if you want to be in, let's talk. → **join the Loop!**
